snippet.title: Crimson Capes - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Crimson Capes is a 2D action - adventure game, built around precise and deliberate swordplay combat. Join the guild of witch-hunters and explore a kingdom full of grim secrets.

Descend into shifting dungeons, cleave through oath-broken knights and blasphemous monstrosities, and face bosses that demand mastery - not grinding.

Coming February 12 2026.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488540/Crimson_Capes/
Join the community: http://discord.gg/DD4JW2bQ8F
Follow updates: https://x.com/CrimsonCapes
